title: Concentration on low-degree Fourier sets
statement: Let $n,k\ge 0$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$. The total squared Fourier weight on sets of cardinality greater than $k$ is at most $\varepsilon$ if and only if the Fourier weight outside the family of all sets of cardinality at most $k$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
